question: I want to know how each of the Straw Hat Pirates like their fried eggs! Do they like them boiled and cut in half, do they like them salty… etc. –
answer: I see… What a fun question–! Let's find out! [Luffy *Sunny side up, almost raw *With mayonnaise Zoro *Over easy, slow-cooked *With shoyu Nami *Sunny side up, coddled *With orange sauce Usopp *Over easy, coddled *With ketchup Sanji *Over easy, coddled *With karakuchi sauce · Chopper *Over easy, slow-cooked *With syrup Robin *Sunny side up, steamed *With black pepper Franky *Over easy, slow-cooked *With butter shoyu Brook *Sunny side up, coddled *With ketchup Jinbe *Sunny side up, steamed *With salt]
name: Odamania
